top_issues: 'Total balance $155.00' sits above 'Spendable now $175.00' with no explanation that spendable exceeds total because it includes hub credit; Rosa reads the bigger number as 'what I have' and is misled.
The 'Two colours, one rule' card is a tutorial that occupies prime home real estate and talks down to repeat users.
Breakdown line (On-chain/Reserve/Secured/Promised) is ~12px grey text — too small for glasses-on reading and the only cue separating 'yours' from 'promised' is a tiny dot colour.
Left rail icons are unlabeled; 'Show 1 empty' is cryptic.
fixes: Add a one-line formula under the headline: 'Spendable = yours $40 + hub credit $135'.
Demote the colour explainer to a dismissible tooltip triggered by the legend, not a persistent card.
Raise breakdown to 14–15px and bold the dollar values; pair each colour with its word (already partly done) at >=4.5:1 contrast.
Show nav labels on hover/focus and replace 'Show 1 empty' with '1 unused token'.

top_issues: Route panel exposes 'forwards atomically · fee 0.0000025 of 0.0000050 total' — protocol noise on a consumer send screen.
Fee shown as 'under 0.01 USDC' is vague for a five-figure transfer (Wei needs the exact bps).
Recipient is a raw hex address; there is no way to pay a person by name/QR, which blocks Rosa's 'send to grandson' task.
Before/After account viz is clever but competes with the primary Pay button for attention.
fixes: Collapse the atomic-forwarding detail behind '1 other route'; show fee in the user's unit (USDC) with exact value, not 'under'.
Add a recipient picker (contacts / scan QR / paste) with the hex as an advanced field.
Keep before/after but label it 'what this does to H1's promise' so its purpose is unmistakable.

top_issues: 'Settled 05:33:05 in 8s' is excellent, but the proof hash is truncated with no copy affordance next to it.
Modal dims the whole app including the just-updated balance, so the user can't see the consequence of the payment without dismissing.
fixes: Put a copy icon on the Proof row and on Frame #82.
Add a 'View in activity' link that closes the modal and selects the entry.

top_issues: '25.50 capacity via H1' is unexplained jargon on a screen a counter (Priya) must use in seconds.
'Prepare incoming account' implies the receiver must configure routing, which is the sender's job per the copy — contradictory.
QR is the only big element; amount field is small and the note field looks disabled.
fixes: Replace 'capacity via H1' with 'most you can receive right now: $25.50' plus a 'raise this' link to Move.
Rename 'Prepare incoming account' to 'Where it will land (optional)' and default it to auto.
Enlarge the QR and add a 'Show full address' fallback for weak connections (Aisha).

top_issues: Receive amount '0.039992' is rendered in faint grey as if a placeholder, undercutting confidence in a live quote.
'Lot rounding 0.000004 USDC stays with you' is an obscure micro-detail that should be in an expand.
Book depth bars have no axis/scale label, so Wei can't gauge size at a glance.
fixes: Render the quoted receive in full-contrast white with a 'quote refreshes in Ns' timer.
Move lot rounding into the fee expand; show exact hub fee in both bps and WETH.
Add a max-size marker to the depth bars.

top_issues: A tooltip ('Account opening requested with zero credit…') overlaps the collateral slider and the 'Extend credit limit' panel — a layout bug that hides controls mid-flow.
The cross-chain swap silently requires opening a credit line with H3 first; the user hits a disabled Swap button at the bottom with no clear path.
Two near-identical 'Gross receive / collateral tariff' blocks and a 'Prepare to receive' card make the page unscannable for Aisha.
LEGS panel uses hollow radio dots that look like unselected inputs.
fixes: Fix tooltip containment (render above the card, never over controls).
Make the prerequisite a numbered stepper: 1 open line → 2 swap, with the second step disabled and explained inline.
Collapse the tariff explainer into the fee row; keep one gross-receive line.
Use checkmark/lock icons for leg states instead of radio circles.

top_issues: 'They owe you, uncovered $90.00' and 'Collateral you posted $60.00' are the two numbers Ingrid cares about but they sit in a dense right-rail list with equal weight to 'Frames signed'.
The 'Cover it' CTA is the most important action on the screen yet is a small inline link.
WETH card shows 'even' and 0.00 with a near-empty bar — visual noise for an unused lane.
fixes: Promote uncovered-exposure + collateral into a two-up 'Risk here' summary above the token cards.
Make 'Cover it' a real button; if collateral is insufficient, route to Move.
Dim or fold zero-value lanes behind 'Show unused token'.

top_issues: The destructive 'Dispute this account…' button is red but lacks a typed-confirmation or consequence summary (frozen funds, withdrawn orders) at the moment of click.
Tabs (Collateral/Credit/Add token/Dispute) appear inside a 'Manage' modal whose other tabs are never shown, so the modal's purpose is ambiguous.
fixes: Require a confirm step listing exactly what freezes and what goes on-chain.
Title the modal by active tab and show the full tab bar so the user knows this is one of four management actions.

top_issues: Header says '5 movements' while the right gutter says '7 movements' — a data inconsistency that erodes Elena's trust in the export.
The mini progress bars under each row (blue/green) are colour-only and unlabeled.
Filters (Payments/Swaps/Settlement/Accounts) have no result counts.
fixes: Compute the movement count once and reuse it; reconcile in/out totals against the list.
Add a tooltip/legend for the per-row bars or drop them.
Show counts per filter chip.

top_issues: Detail panel is strong (Frame, Proof, '2 committed entries', 'From your runtime's committed frames') but the proof hash is truncated with no copy button.
'Swap filled' row shows no fill price, only status — Wei can't reconcile a fill from the list.
fixes: Add copy affordances on Proof and Frame.
Surface executed price/size on swap rows and in the detail panel.

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Forget vault' are irreversible/key-exposing actions sitting as plain buttons with no visible guard.
Four design axes (Material/Accent/Numbers/Risk colour) plus a '1 px = $1' bar-scale meta-setting overload a wallet settings page.
Risk-colour = Violet is a colour-only semantic choice; users who can't distinguish violet must rely on labels everywhere.
fixes: Gate reveal behind auth + 'never share' warning; gate Forget behind typed confirmation.
Move appearance/design presets behind an 'Appearance' sub-page; keep Home/Runtime/Vault on top.
Always render the word next to the risk colour (already done in places) and add a high-contrast mode.

top_issues: The FROM/TO 3×3 matrix is clear, but selecting Reserve→Account shows 'WHAT HAPPENS: Fund you through H1' with a hollow radio that reads as a control, not a status.
No fee/ETA line on Move, unlike Pay — Aisha can't compare cost of moving on-chain vs via hub.
fixes: Turn the WHAT-HAPPENS marker into a labelled outcome chip ('on-chain, ~1 block' / 'instant, via H1').
Add fee + arrival to Move like Pay.

top_issues: 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' duplicates the home breakdown with different wording ('Yours whatever a hub does' vs 'On-chain/Reserve'), risking inconsistency.
Five entry cards are equal-weight; the most-used (Move) isn't promoted.
NEEDS ATTENTION card is empty yet takes vertical space.
fixes: Use identical labels and numbers as home for the same concepts.
Order cards by recency/frequency; collapse empty attention card.

top_issues: Right FAUCETS column stacks a token grid, amount, a collateral slider, 'Extend credit limit', and four receive buttons — a single screen doing three jobs.
'Receive USDC from H1' is disabled with no reason shown.
All token balances 0.00 with 'Depository may pull 0.00' is meaningless noise for a new user.
fixes: Split faucet (testnet) into its own route; keep Assets = holdings + debts.
Explain disabled state inline ('no H1 account yet → Open').
Hide zero-value 'may pull' lines until non-zero.

top_issues: Pool shows Available/Borrowed/Active principal all 0.00, so Omar can't see what a hub pool actually looks like when working.
Borrow tab exists but its terms/requirements are never shown in this state.
'= 1.00% per term' is good, but there's no APR-normalisation for comparing terms.
fixes: Provide a populated example or a 'how pools work' diagram when empty.
Show borrow rate/collateral expectations on the Borrow tab.
Add annualised equivalent next to per-term rate.

top_issues: Mostly empty; 'lazy entity', 'EntityProvider', 'rotation signed by the current board' are protocol terms with no plain-language gloss.
No visible path to actually add a signer or raise the threshold — the most important action is absent.
Large dead whitespace on the right and bottom.
fixes: Add an 'Add signer / change threshold' primary action (even if it opens a builder).
Gloss each term on first use; show a 1-of-1 → 2-of-3 example diagram.

top_issues: PER COUNTERPARTY card text overflows the right edge ('…open → Manage → Disput' is clipped) — a real layout bug on the screen meant to build trust.
'Enforceable right now $40.00' vs home's 'On-chain $0 + Reserve $40' uses a different frame of reference without linking them.
Save evidence bundle / Print report are great but the 'at risk $90' figure isn't actionable from here (no Cover/Dispute button).
fixes: Constrain the counterparty card width and wrap the action hint.
Cross-link the enforceable number to the home breakdown.
Add 'Cover it' / 'Dispute' buttons next to the at-risk figure.

top_issues: Account·Lane table right column 'CREDIT OUT…' is truncated at the panel edge — the exact exposure number a pro wants is cut off.
Four summary cards + table + book + recent compete with no clear reading order; first-time users will bounce.
Book and table use different colour semantics for the same lane states.
fixes: Make the table horizontally scrollable or drop a column so CREDIT OUT is fully visible.
Add an 'Enter Desk' explainer or default to Comfort layout.
Unify lane-state colours with home/account.

top_issues: Hints ('send money', 'dense console') help, but the overlay leaves the underlying page half-lit with no visible keyboard selection cue.
No recent/frequent items pinned at top.
fixes: Show a clear active-row highlight and ↑↓ hint.
Add a 'Recent' group above the alphabetical list.

overall.verdict: A genuinely distinctive, premium, trust-forward wallet whose colour-and-bar model and per-frame proof story beat most competitors for power users (Wei, Elena, Noah, Ingrid). It loses novices and breaks its own promises on a handful of layout bugs and jargon walls that make the safety story hard to read at a glance.
priority_fixes: Fix the layout defects that hide or clip information on trust-critical screens: the 05b tooltip overlapping controls, the 15-sovereignty PER COUNTERPARTY text overflow, the 16-desk truncated CREDIT OUT column, and the 07 movement-count mismatch.

Add progressive disclosure so 'capacity', 'frames', 'bps', 'lot rounding', 'lazy entity' and 'atomic forwarding' never appear on a primary action path; keep one plain-language sentence per concept with a 'more' expand.

Reconcile the home numbers: show why Spendable ($175) > Total ($155) with an explicit yours-vs-credit formula, and make the green/violet rule readable without the tutorial card and without colour-only cues.
Turn cross-chain (05b) into a guided stepper that surfaces the 'open a credit line first' prerequisite before the disabled Swap button, so Aisha can complete a hub-mediated chain move.
Add a people-first Pay/Receive mode (name/QR/contacts) so sending to a person doesn't require understanding entity ids, and promote the uncovered-exposure 'Cover it' action everywhere it appears.

02-pay: recipient is a hex address, no way to pay a person by name
colour-only risk cues (violet/green) on 09-settings risk colour

personas.name: Jamal
personas.verdict: I can watch money land and 'spendable now' tells me what I can use today, but I'm not sure the $175 is really mine.
blockers: 01-home: credit-inflated spendable risks overspending
07-activity: per-row colour bars are unlabeled
Move (10) lacks fee/ETA so cashing out weekly feels blind

07-activity: 5 vs 7 movements mismatch undermines the export

personas.name: Wei

08-activity: swap rows don't show fill price

10-move: no fee/ETA for on-chain vs hub
12-assets: faucet flow conflated with holdings

01-home: 'Promised/Secured/capacity' vocabulary

05/06: hub fee shown as '1 bps' / 'under 0.01' without an operator-side revenue view
06-account: dispute SLA shown but no hub-side obligations summary
